text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: From its entrance, {0} and Hiyori were looking up at the Tower of Luna.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}とヒヨリは
ルナの塔を入り口から見上げていた。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: So this is the Tower of Luna... Way bigger than I had imagined!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここがルナの塔かあ……
思ってたより大きいんだね。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: This is where the hints to restore Kishi-kun's memories lie... Alright, let's do our best and CLIMBBBB!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここに騎士くんの記憶を取り戻すヒントがあるんだね。
よーし、
頑張って登ろー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: He-he-he... I heard that both Yui-chan and Rei-chan came here with you before. Therefore, there's no way I'd be left out of helping you, Kishi-kun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふー
ユイちゃんもレイさんも
来たことあるって聞いてたからね。
あたしも
騎士くんのお手伝いがしたかったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's get right to it... Huh? C-Can you hear something coming?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあさっそく……
あれ？
何か聞こえない？

text_block_list.text: ...WHEW!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ッスー！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Please wait just a second! Hah... hah... I've finally... caught up to you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ってほしいッスよー！
はぁ……
はぁ……
やっと……
追いついたッス……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're Matsuri from the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE, right? What's wrong? Is there some ongoing investigation involving us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】のマツリちゃん……
だよね？
どうかしたの？　
もしかして、
なにか事件の調査？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: No, pal! I came after you when I heard you were going to challenge the Tower of Luna! I want you to take me along with you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
違うッス！
あんたたちが
ルナの塔に挑むと知って
追いかけてきたッス！
自分も
ぜひ連れてってほしいッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: You even went out of your way to chase after us all the way here... Is there a reason why?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わざわざ追いかけてきたってことは……
なにか理由があるの？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: From what I've heard from Tomo-nee-chan and the others, there's hints in the Tower of Luna that'll help restore his memories, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
トモね～ちゃんたちから聞いた話だと
ルナの塔には、
{0}さんの
記憶を取り戻す
ヒントがあるッスよね？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: In that case, it's only natural for a Hero like me to help conquer the tower! I owe {0}-san a lot for helping me too, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なら、
塔の攻略を助けるのは
ヒーローとして当然のことッス！
{0}さんには
世話になってるッスからね。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm on board! Nice to work with you, Matsuri-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしはもちろん賛成だよ！
よ
ろしくね、
マツリちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Thanks, pal! Worry not, I won't hold you back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうッス！
足手まといにはならないッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Don't treat me like a kid, pal! I've been training every day and I'm much stronger than when I first met you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
子供扱いはやめてほしいッス！
毎日の特訓で、
あんたと出会った時よりも
バッチリ強くなってるッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, we've fought together a few times, so I know how reliable you can be. Nice to work with you, Matsuri-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん、
何回か一緒に戦ったこともあるし
頼りになるのは知ってるよ。
よろしくね、
マツリちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Hiyori-san, right? It's not like we're strangers, but I believe this is the first time we're in the situation to have a proper discussion.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリさん、
ッスよね。
知らない仲じゃあないッスけど、
こうしてゆっくりお話しするのは
初めてッスね。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Actually, you're right! Ehehe, I've always wanted to have a long talk with you, Matsuri-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
えへへ、
あたし、
マツリちゃんとは一度ゆっくりお話ししたかったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-With me, pal?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ？　
じ、
自分とッスか？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Even outside of the battlefield, I've always seen you around here and there in Landosol, Matsuri-chan, and something's been bothering me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
戦いの場以外でも、
ランドソルで
マツリちゃんのことちょくちょく見かけてて
気になってて。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Is it something related to my NIGHTMARE activities?
text_block_list.orig_text: 【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】の活動の時ッスかね？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Matsuri-chan was alone at the time so that's probably not it. You were in the beastfolk living quarters... I believe your house is around there too, right, Matsuri-chan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マツリちゃん一人でいたから違うんじゃないかなあ。
獣人の居住区のほうでなんだけど……
マツリちゃんの家も
あのあたりなんだよね？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: UWEH?! U-Umm, I'm not actually a beastfolk...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええと
自分は獣人じゃ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: You see, back then... I had seen Matsuri-chan giving directions to lost people and helping folks find lost items!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしね、
マツリちゃんが道に迷ってる人の案内をしたり、
落とし物を探してあげたりしてるのを
見かけてたんだ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Huh? S-So you saw me doing all that? I didn't notice at all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
見られてたッスか？
全然気が付かなかったッス……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Huh... Come to think of it, I've also seen you around the beastfolk living quarters before, Hiyori-san.
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
そういえば自分も
獣人の居住区で
ヒヨリさんを見かけたことがあるッスよ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: If I recall correctly... you were hanging around helping the elderly and some kids. Maybe... you were doing the same thing I was?
text_block_list.orig_text:
たしか、
お年寄りや子供と一緒だったッス。
もしかして……
自分と同じことしてたッスか？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Actually, you're right on that. Ah, see what I was thinking is that there was another girl doing what I always do. Therefore being able to go on an adventure together makes me very happy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
実はそうなんだ。
あー、
あたしと同じことしてる子がいるなって
思って。
だから一緒に冒険できてうれしいな。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: So you're on the same wavelength I am, down to doing the same things, Hiyori-san. That's reassuring!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリさんも自分と同じことをしてたッスね。
それは心強いッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Once again, working together will be a pleasure, Matsuri-chan. Let's help Kishi-kun regain his memories!
text_block_list.orig_text:
改めてよろしくね、
マツリちゃん。
一緒に騎士くんの記憶を取り戻すお手伝いをしよう！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Same here, I'll be counting on you, pal! Alright, let's charge in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こちらこそよろしく頼むッス！
よ
ーし、
それじゃあさっそく
突撃ッスよー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yeeeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: おー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, {0}, Hiyori, and Matsuri made their way inside the Tower of Luna.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして{0}とヒヨリ、マツリは
ルナの塔へと向かうのであった。
